title: Did caloric restriction slow biological aging in the CALERIE trial?
question: Identify what the CALERIE DNA-methylation analysis measured and whether its results establish slower biological aging, slower clinical aging, or longer human life.
verdict_question: Did the study establish that caloric restriction slows aging in humans?

source.title: Effect of long-term caloric restriction on DNA methylation measures of biological aging in healthy adults from the CALERIE trial
source.license: CC BY 4.0, as stated in Crossref metadata; verify before reusing text

fields: whether clinical outcomes or lifespan were measured
acceptance_criteria: Every numerical fact points to a source section, table or figure
Report each methylation measure separately; do not merge null and positive results
Distinguish intention-to-treat from per-protocol or dose-response analyses
Do not equate a slower methylation pace with longer life or fewer diseases
result_destination: Submit to https://longevidence.org/challenge/api/submit (see join.txt). Public, marked unreviewed.
publication_acceptance: submissions are public drafts; not reviewed or accepted until marked by a reviewer
